reddit.title: Introducing Enhanced Material Management in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to the building mechanics in Provincia! Instead of a single cost chip that often misrepresents what's needed, each build tile now displays a comprehensive materials list. You can easily see what resources you have versus what you need, with any shortages clearly highlighted. This change allows for better planning and management of your colony's construction projects. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Enhanced Building Mechanics in Provincia
steam.body: We’re thrilled to announce a major update to the building system in Provincia! Build tiles now feature a detailed materials list instead of a single cost chip. This update allows players to easily track their resources, showing stored vs required materials and highlighting any shortages. This improvement will greatly assist in planning and executing your construction projects. For a deeper dive into this update, visit: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
